name: Gol Mangoli
overview: The main character of this series is "Goli", who creates interesting and controversial adventures every time he faces new situations, and his role is played by Mahaya Petrosian. Goli is an example of an authentic, pure and innocent Iranian girl who, in every part of this series, gets involved in new situations and jobs, she gets involved in incidents and problems, which she tries to overcome by relying on her intelligence.
